title: Browser Use can now pay with your credit card using Stripe Link CLI
summary: You can safely connect your credit card and purchase things with hosted browser agents.
body_markdown:
Connect[Link](https://link.com/) once. When the agent reaches a checkout it asks to pay, your phone buzzes, you approve, and Link hands it a virtual card good for exactly that purchase. The agent fills the form and pays. The card is gone after. Your real card number never leaves Link.


## How it works


1. **Connect Link** once, under Integrations.
2. **The agent asks to pay.** Amount, merchant, and what it is buying.
3. **You approve in the Link app.** Nothing is charged before this.
4. **Link issues a one-time card.** Valid for hours, good for one purchase.
5. **The agent checks out** and reports back.


The agent never holds your Link token, cannot approve for itself, and can pay anywhere a card works. On Stripe checkouts that advertise agent payments it can pay with a Link Pay Token instead and never touch a card number.


## Try it


Open[cloud.browser-use.com](https://cloud.browser-use.com/) , connect Link under Integrations, start a task with **Pay with Link** on, and ask it to buy something.


We gave an AI a credit card on purpose.[Tell us what it should buy.](https://x.com/browser_use)


Read more:[Link for agents](https://link.com/agents) ,[link-cli](https://github.com/stripe/link-cli) , and[paying with crypto over x402](https://browser-use.com/posts/x402-launch) .
